affordability.title: Affordability checks for short-term credit — overview (synthetic)
affordability.snippet: A lender is expected to verify income from evidence, assess regular expenditure, and consider the credit file before each advance, repeating the checks when repayments become a large share of income.

affordability.title: Repeat lending and rollover patterns (synthetic)
affordability.snippet: Three or more consecutive loans within twelve months, rollovers, and escalating amounts without new evidence are treated as indicators that lending was not affordable.

ombudsman.title: Escalating a lending complaint (synthetic)
ombudsman.snippet: If a lender rejects a complaint, the borrower may refer it to the ombudsman; a referral should set out the loans, the checks that were or were not performed, and the rules relied on.

complaint letter.title: Structure of an irresponsible-lending complaint letter (synthetic)
complaint letter.snippet: State the loans and dates, the affordability checks the lender says it performed, the specific rules not met, the patterns present, and the remedy sought.
